Step 3. Applying the bounded interpolation theorem to \(U_{01340013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via spectral interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01340011 \cdot C_01340012 \cdot C_01340013\).
